title: Sweet and Spicy Chicken Stir-Fry Sauce
description: Orange and honey give this chicken glaze a sweet opening and a warm chile finish.

steps.title: Start the sauce
steps.text: Warm {oil} in the 10-inch HexClad skillet over medium-low heat.

steps.title: Toast gently
steps.text: Stir {garlic}, {ancho} into the oil for 30 seconds, just until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer the base
steps.text: Whisk in {broth}, {orange}, {honey}, {amino}, {ricevin} gradually. Simmer gently for 5–7 minutes until the flavors come together.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Pour the slurry into the simmering sauce while whisking. Bubble gently for 1 minute until it coats a spoon.

steps.title: Finish the sauce
steps.text: Fold in {sesame} off heat. Measure into a heatproof jug; add hot water to reach 1 cup, or simmer excess away before serving.

notes: Yield: 1 cup. Low-sodium option for the full batch: reduce coconut aminos to 4 g and keep the same final yield. Use unsalted broth throughout. Option A uses the listed seasonings. For a gentler Option B, omit citrus or vinegar and replace its weight with water. Make ahead: chill in small jars for up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes, freeze in quarter-cup portions up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: whisk over low heat to 165°F. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat as above. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 52 kcal, 0.5 g protein, 8.9 g total carbohydrate, 1.8 g fat, 0.2 g fiber, 78 mg sodium. Low-sodium version per 1/4 cup: 49 kcal, 0.5 g protein, 8.1 g total carbohydrate, 1.8 g fat, 0.2 g fiber, 24 mg sodium.
